portedFromTheOracle.surfaceStart: src/game-loop.js updateSurface(): no dive time at the surface; S or the down arrow sets 2 L in the BCD, at rest, the loop's PO2, and starts the dive, whose next frame vents. createInitialDiveState already holds those values, so the transition changes no state. Legacy's 'surface' autosave is kept: the waiting state is handed to the save.
portedFromTheOracle.bounds: Legacy's ceilingAt/floorAt, solidAt and overheadAt, on the migration scene's own hull (src/sites/wreck-route.ts, which the renderer now draws from): the surface to 34 m outside the hold; over the cargo hold and engine room, open water above the deck and, under it, the deck's underside to the hold's 33.5 m floor, which is the overhead. A horizontal stroke into the hull is not made.
portedFromTheOracle.completion: Surfacing outside the wreck reaches the model's completion (slice 4b); under the deck the diver cannot surface.
